Meet the Baker

Hi, I’m the Baker Behind TailWaggz Dog Barkery

I started TailWaggz Dog Barkery because I believe every dog deserves to be celebrated. From birthday pupcakes to everyday snack boxes, every treat I bake is made from wholesome, dog-safe ingredients with real love.

No preservatives, no shortcuts. Just fresh-baked goodness your pup will go absolutely wild for. DM me on Instagram to place your order — I’d love to bake something special for your furry family member.

Why Choose Us

Treats That Taste as Good as They Look

Every treat from TailWaggz Dog Barkery is made from scratch with ingredients you can actually read. No artificial colors, no fillers — just real food your dog will love.

Whether your pup loves peanut butter, sweet potato, or something seasonal — we make it fresh, exactly the way they like it.
